handoff.summary: commit-protocol (#7) extracted to canon — the six blocks' semantics documented
handoff.done:
**Backlog #7 — commit-protocol to canon** (commit 11ad743, pushed + CI-verified green run 27574744393 conclusion=success). Seventh Akili to SOCOM extraction. The commit format `type(scope): desc` + six blocks `[what][why][how][test][broke][next]` was already ENFORCED (commit-msg gate: subject RED, [what]/[test] amber) and named in constitution §structured-commits, but the per-block MEANING lived nowhere. Shipped `commit-protocol.xml` (byte-identical twins canon/ + .socom/canon/, added to CANON_FILES) documenting each block's distinct semantics + Akili's discipline (journey / verbatim-errors / dead-ends / one-logical-change / verification-non-negotiable / grep-the-journey) as the teaching layer. render_body emits a `## Commit protocol` section mirroring the #5 residuality block; compiled into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.cursor + L1-indexed (13 chunks).
**Port the pattern, not the block names**: SOCOM keeps its six blocks (the gate + constitution depend on them) — this DOCUMENTS their meaning, does not restructure them. Gate left ADVISORY on the four soft blocks (velocity-first, §psychological-acceptability).
**Design fork decided** (plan + residuality gate): Option A (canon file, mirrors residuality.xml) chosen over Option B (.gitmessage + git config commit.template). B touches machine-local git config — not git-source-of-truth, won't propagate to clones — and the gap was documentation, which A fully closes. B leashed as #7b.
Independent reviewer (clean context) verdict ACCEPT-WITH-NITS, 8/8 contract checks re-run after final edit. One cosmetic nit fixed (rendered table cell repeated its own `[id] —` label; stripped in render_body, recompiled). Evidence: diff twins empty; both parse; in CANON_FILES; section in CLAUDE.md; doctor clean (source=022e67cc361f); index 13 "artifact":"commit-protocol" chunks; xmlcheck 27 well-formed; smoke green; unit 51 passed; full-ok; pre-commit + pre-push gates PASS; CI green.
